retrievalProfile.description: A centered, glowing vintage jukebox with chrome accents and neon lighting against a dark blue gradient background, topped with bold italicized sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring a classic arched jukebox as the central subject. The machine is characterized by warm internal orange lighting, vibrant neon side tubes in green and pink, and polished chrome hardware. The background is a deep navy blue with a subtle radial glow behind the jukebox, creating a halo effect that emphasizes the silhouette.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical jukebox centered horizontally and vertically
Warm internal orange light contrasting with cool blue background
Bold white typography positioned in the upper third
Chrome highlights reflecting the internal and external light sources
coreInvariants: Arched top silhouette of the jukebox
Visible record-stacking mechanism inside the glass
Vertical neon light tubes on the left and right pillars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The jukebox is the dominant central figure, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange internal glow of the jukebox's upper arch.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white title at the top, moves down the curved arch of the jukebox, and settles on the colorful neon pillars and internal details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue space surrounding the jukebox, concentrated in the upper corners.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light sources against a low-value, dark background to create a 'glowing' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Square-ish proportions with rounded outer corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '5' features a sharp horizontal top bar and a wide, open curve
The 'S' is compact and follows the same slant angle as the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face for impact; secondary text should be a script font if placed on the jukebox labels.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square-ish, heavy, mid-century technical look.
Provides the same geometric, wide-set retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail photograph of a vintage 1950s jukebox with chrome trim and neon lights, centered against a dark blue radial gradient background. Ensure the internal lights are glowing amber.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, extended italic sans-serif text centered at the top of the frame with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a strong rightward slant?
Are the neon colors vibrant against the dark blue?
Is the chrome reflecting the surrounding light?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the jukebox
postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical alignment of the jukebox
Ensure the white text is legible against the blue background
Verify the 'glow' effect doesn't wash out the chrome details
Confirm the typography is italicized and extended
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Subject (Jukebox) + Radial Glow Background + Bold Extended Italic Header = Retro Music Aesthetic
